title: Vampire Vape Berries Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Looking for your next summery all-day vape? Look no further, this refreshing blend of summer berries is bound to tantalise your tastebuds with its fresh and fruity flavour. Every inhale and exhale features an indulgent breeze of berry flavours. PG Based Flavour Concentrate to be used only in E-Liquid. Dilute to suit the user, between 15-20% depending on required flavour strength. Contents approx 30ml. All flavours made from the highest quality ingredients and made in the UK in a clean room from creation to bottling. All come with batch numbers and expiry dates. Sample liquids held for future testing to ensure the highest quality product. If it doesn’t pass QC it doesn’t go out the door. This is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Made in the UK
